name: nexus-athena
description: Spec-driven planning framework (v3+v3.1+v3.3), shipped as a Claude Code plugin + a Hermes plugin (hermes/HERMES_PLUGIN.md). Drives Spec-Kit /specify -> CRISP design -> EARS->GWT scenarios -> deterministic compile into a Beads (bd) durable PROVENANCE graph (spec->design->epic->task + verifies/satisfies edges). v3.3 roots that graph in a REQUIREMENT CONTRACT: numbered clauses with immutable ids, supersede/branch semantics, per-clause version pins and an executable-spec ledger, so 'which requirements have no spec / what is left / where did requirement, spec and code diverge' are linear scans. success_check = requirement proved, not just test-passed. 23 planner_* MCP verbs. v3.4 adds a deterministic mutation runner (does a spec prove anything?) and a measured-not-trusted local-model judge pilot; v3.5 adds `athena check` (the whole loop, one exit code) and `athena init` (scaffold); v3.6 makes the line map honest (an empty entry can no longer pass for a proved one) and adds `athena contract outline` — the architecture derived from the map rather than written down. Validated by evals/ (real pipeline = 92% mean recall over a 5-task set).
